item.description: - Motion now starts more smoothly on 120 Hz displays. - Butterfly now uses your Mac's accent color in the menu, Settings, the tour and the license window. - Settings, the tour and the practice strip share one set of greys and one corner scale. - Clearer names: "New workspace", "Start at login" and "Tour…".

- Press the mouse wheel and move up to open Overview, or down to show the desktop. - Moving all windows of a workspace in Overview now takes you to that workspace. - Flapping icons in Overview and on the desktop no longer show a frame. - Butterfly now comes as a disk image: open it and drag Butterfly to Applications.

- Apps with a minimum width, like Music and TV, no longer slide over their neighbors on smaller screens. - The tour now teaches Overview and showing the desktop, and only takes your gestures while its window is in front. - When macOS uses the same trackpad gestures, Butterfly tells you exactly which switches to turn off. - License checks recover as soon as your Mac is back online, with clearer messages about moving a license to another Mac. - Updating from the old Chain app no longer asks for an administrator password.
